description: Environment variables in holon-coherence are read ad hoc with os.getenv across modules with inconsistent bool/port parsing instead of a frozen, typed CoherenceSettings.from_env() configuration object.
goal: Create a frozen, typed CoherenceSettings dataclass with a from_env(environ=None) factory in src/holon_coherence/settings.py (at most 200 lines) providing uniform bool, int/port, optional string, and path parsing for holon-coherence environment variables, and route src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/runner.py, and src/holon_coherence/ringer_orchestrator.py through CoherenceSettings.from_env() without import-time env freezes. Keep all modified/created files at or below 200 lines and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Add comprehensive unit tests in tests/test_settings.py verifying bool/port/string/path defaults, edge cases, and immutability, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Centralizing environment variable parsing into CoherenceSettings.from_env() prevents inconsistent bool/port parsing and import-time freezes.
acceptance_criteria: All environment variables in src/holon_coherence/settings.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/runner.py, and src/holon_coherence/ringer_orchestrator.py are parsed through CoherenceSettings.from_env() with unit-tested bool/port defaults in tests/test_settings.py.
tests/test_settings.py passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint with zero docstrings or comments and unchanged holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.
